item.title: Pentagon considers diverting Ukraine military aid to the Middle East
item.summary: A shift would highlight the growing trade-offs required for the U.S. to sustain its war with Iran as the conflict depletes the military’s critical munitions.

item.title: Gulf countries want Trump to end Iran war — but not yet, officials say
item.summary: The Saudis and Emiratis fear a deal that leaves the region less stable, and they have indicated support for an escalated campaign to force concessions from Tehran.

item.title: Iraq accuses U.S. of killing 7 soldiers in clinic strike
item.summary: As Iraq claimed “heinous aggression,” the U.S. denied it targeted a clinic. The incident threatens to sour relations between the countries amid the Iran war.

item.title: U.S. plan to end war seeks removal of Iran’s enriched uranium, officials say
item.summary: The proposal offered sanctions relief to Iran in return for the removal of all its enriched uranium and other U.S. demands, officials said.

item.title: Russia hits Ukrainian cities, intensifying bombing as U.S. focuses on Iran
item.summary: Ukraine said eight people were killed as Russia launched a bombardment that included its largest single-day drone assault of the war.

item.title: Iran’s missiles pierce Israel’s defenses, raising doubts about interceptors
item.summary: Concern that Iran was amassing missiles to overwhelm defenses was a key factor in the push for war, officials said, and recent strikes laid bare Israel’s vulnerability.

item.title: Army paratroopers ordered to Middle East as U.S. weighs next move in Iran conflict
item.summary: The orders follow weeks of speculation about whether the 82nd Airborne Division would join the war, after its headquarters unit abruptly pulled out of a training exercise this month.

item.title: Tehran denies claims of progress in peace talks, as Trump declares war ‘won’
item.summary: President Donald Trump said that peace negotiations with representatives from Iran were ongoing: “They want to make a deal so badly.”

item.title: Israel, Iran trade strikes as U.S. says it is pausing attacks on energy targets
item.summary: Four Persian Gulf states reported fresh missile and drone threats from Iran, as Israel pledged to keep up its attacks in Iran and Lebanon “with full force.”

item.title: Israel says it killed Iran’s top naval commander in bid to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: Israel said Alireza Tangsiri, commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ navy, was responsible for blocking the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian authorities did not immediately comment.
